ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast; approximately 35-40% high-intensity pixels (white/light-grey) vs 60-65% low-intensity pixels (black/dark-grey) across the visible ventral surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity zones on distal lobe tips and the lower-medial section of the left lobe. Extensive white-on-black stippling (pixel-level mottling) in central regions. Left lobe features vertical dark linear streaks within the white base patch, while the right lobe shows concentrated mottling along the outer margin.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an estimated interior angle of 34 degrees and significant bounding-box depth relative to the lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Regular, high-frequency serration along the continuous trailing edge; peaks average 5-12 pixels in amplitude with sharp, narrow valleys creating a jagged linear boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Outer margins follow a convex arc; trailing edges exhibit a concave sweep converging toward the central median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense concentrations of roughly circular, high-relief barnacle clusters at both distal fluke tips. Numerous discrete circular white scars (3-15 pixel diameter) distributed across black pigmented regions, likely representing attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Visible parallel dark linear streaks (rake marks) on the lower-left white patch; additional scattered unaligned linear disruptions breaking the pigmentation on both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization at distal extremities; heavy rake mark patterns and multi-generational circular scarring across the entire visible fluke surface.
other_distinctive_markers: The barnacle colonies create a distinct 'fringed' textural profile on the tips, significantly altering the expected smooth geometric contour of the distal fluke margins.
